unit.name: Monkey D. Luffy
unit.summary: A cheerful elastic captain who fights through long reach, increasingly powerful Haki-enhanced strikes, and battlefield awareness adapted from Observation Haki.

actions.name: Gum-Gum Pistol
actions.summary: Luffy stretches and slingshots one elastic punch at a distant enemy.

actions.name: Observation Burst
actions.summary: Luffy focuses his awareness on a distant enemy and reveals nearby enemies around it.

abilities.name: Observation Burst
abilities.summary: Manually reveal an enemy and nearby enemies for a short duration.

paths.name: Rubber Reach
paths.summary: Extends Luffy's elastic attacks and adds bounded projectile pierce.

paths.name: Gears and Armament
paths.summary: Improves the damage and cadence of Luffy's physical strikes.

paths.name: Observation and Liberation
paths.summary: Adds battlefield reveal and a manually focused awareness burst.

nodes.name: Long Stretch
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol range to 25 world units.

nodes.name: Slingshot Speed
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol projectile speed to 36 world units per second.

nodes.name: Further Extension
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol range to 31 world units.

nodes.name: Piercing Pistol
nodes.summary: Each Gum-Gum Pistol projectile can hit up to two distinct targets.

nodes.name: Elastic Mastery
nodes.summary: Finish the reach path with 38 world units of range and 44 projectile speed.

nodes.name: Gear Two Tempo
nodes.summary: Reduce Gum-Gum Pistol cooldown to 0.9 seconds.

nodes.name: Haki-Hardened Blow
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol damage to 6 hit points.

nodes.name: Controlled Gear
nodes.summary: Reduce Gum-Gum Pistol cooldown to 0.7 seconds.

nodes.name: Giant Impact
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol damage to 10 hit points.

nodes.name: Compressed Conqueror
nodes.summary: Finish the burst path with 14 damage and a 0.5-second cadence.

nodes.name: Keen Awareness
nodes.summary: Gum-Gum Pistol reveals its struck target for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Held in Sight
nodes.summary: Increase the primary attack's reveal duration to 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Focused Observation
nodes.summary: Unlock the manually activated Observation Burst ability.

nodes.name: Protective Awareness
nodes.summary: Increase primary reveal duration to 7 seconds and extend Observation Burst to 32 world units.

nodes.name: Liberation Sight
nodes.summary: Finish the awareness path with 10-second attack reveals and a 5-second Observation Burst reveal.

visuals.description: Monkey D. Luffy wearing a straw hat, red vest, blue shorts, and sandals.
A stretched elastic arm launches forward as a large stylized punch.
Higher damage tiers add dark Armament Haki accents around the striking limb.

animations.description: Luffy winds back his arm, stretches it, and snaps it forward in a Gum-Gum Pistol.
Luffy briefly focuses with an alert expression while a circular awareness effect marks revealed enemies.
High-tier attacks use exaggerated elastic compression and release before impact.

audio.description: A rubber snap and energetic impact sound accompany Gum-Gum Pistol.
A brief focused pulse sound plays when Observation Burst is activated.

uncheckedRules: Character fidelity and prose/mechanic agreement require review.
The consuming game must implement these mechanics.
Runtime reachability, numerical balance and enjoyable progression are not established.

findings.evidence: Rubber Reach tier 2 is summarized as increasing projectile speed to 36, but its first operation writes projectilesPerCycle and its second operation redundantly resets range to 25. The tier therefore does not implement its stated speed upgrade. Tier 5 claims projectile speed 44 but has no projectile-speed operation.
findings.change: Replace tier 2's first operation with a projectileSpeedWorldUnitsPerSecond set to 36, remove its redundant range operation, and append a tier 5 operation setting projectileSpeedWorldUnitsPerSecond to 44.

findings.evidence: Observation Burst is an aura with radius 8 and is described as revealing nearby enemies, but both targeting.maximumTargets and delivery.maximumTargetsPerProjectile are 1. The radius therefore cannot produce the advertised area-awareness interaction; it can reveal only one acquired target.
findings.change: Raise both finite target caps to 8 so the aura can reveal a bounded group around the focused enemy.

uncertainties: The supplied diagnostics do not measure reveal utility directly, so the proposed Observation Burst cap increase is a mechanical consistency repair rather than a demonstrated balance improvement.

The source supports elastic reach and Observation-based awareness, but does not establish numerical projectile speeds, target caps, or reveal-area size; those values remain adaptation choices within the contract.

limits: Source fidelity review remains model judgment. Diagnostics are uncalibrated mechanical evidence.
A rejected or failed review preserves the draft; structural success does not mean the review succeeded.
Only complete valid transactions are committed. Large redesigns and missing top-level structures may remain unrepaired.
Feasibility and source attribution remain model judgments. A supported claim in the plan is not an independent verification of the final implementation.

plan.identity: Public design specification and feasibility report for Monkey D. Luffy, using the supplied One Piece manga-continuity record only. Unit role: damage with limited information support. Purchase cost: 600 credits. Base attack: Gum-Gum Pistol, a ranged elastic punch projectile. Three independent paths compose as one primary path through tier 5 plus one crosspath through tier 2. Feasible subset: elastic reach, ranged slিং

baseAttack.description: Gum-Gum Pistol: Luffy stretches and slingshots his arm as a single-target ranged projectile. Damage 3, range 20 world units, projectile speed 28 world units per second, interval 1.1 seconds, maximum one target per projectile.

paths.name: Rubber Reach
progression: Tier 1: increase attack range to 25 world units.
Tier 2: increase projectile speed to 36 world units per second.
Tier 3: increase attack range to 31 world units.
Tier 4: allow the projectile to hit up to 2 distinct targets.
Tier 5: increase attack range to 38 world units and projectile speed to 44 world units per second.

paths.name: Gears and Armament
progression: Tier 1: reduce attack interval to 0.9 seconds, adapting Gear 2's speed increase into an attack cadence upgrade.
Tier 2: increase damage to 6, representing stronger elastic strikes and basic Armament Haki.
Tier 3: reduce attack interval to 0.7 seconds, representing improved Gear control.
Tier 4: increase damage to 10, adapting Gear 3's enlarged high-damage blows and Armament enhancement.
Tier 5: reduce attack interval to 0.5 seconds and increase damage to 14, adapting Gear 4 compression power and advanced Armament into permanent attack properties rather than a runtime transformation.

paths.name: Observation and Liberation
progression: Tier 1: attacks reveal struck targets for 2 seconds.
Tier 2: increase reveal duration to 4 seconds.
Tier 3: revealed targets are prioritized over unrevealed eligible targets.
Tier 4: increase reveal duration to 7 seconds and allow revealed targets to remain detectable through ordinary concealment.
Tier 5: attacks reveal all enemies within 8 world units of the struck target for 3 seconds, adapting Observation Haki's presence detection and Luffy's protective battlefield awareness.

mechanics.name: Elastic projectile
mechanics.implementation: The base attack uses a finite-speed projectile to represent Luffy's stretched, slingshot punch. Range and projectile speed are upgraded only by Rubber Reach; damage and cadence are upgraded only by Gears and Armament.

mechanics.name: Observation reveal
mechanics.implementation: An attack may reveal its acquired target for an explicit duration. The final path tier adds a secondary reveal around that target; no future sight, prediction guarantee, or manual removal mechanic is asserted.

mechanics.name: Armament damage adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Armament Haki is represented by owned damage upgrades. Defense increase, Devil Fruit negation, target penetration, and internal destruction are not independently modeled.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 2 as a temporary body transformation with energy drain, physical strain, and possible lifespan cost.
omissions.reason: Runtime transformations, health or generic stat modifiers, and unsupported strain/lifespan behavior are excluded. Its speed characteristic is adapted honestly into Gears and Armament attack-interval upgrades, not presented as a transformation.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 3's air-filled enlarged bones and its original post-use shrinking drawback.
omissions.reason: The body transformation and post-use state transfer are unsupported. Its high-damage characteristic is adapted into a permanent damage upgrade.
The design has no runtime forms or combination-state system, so simultaneous Gear activation is omitted.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 4's inflated-muscle body, Armament coating, compression attacks, and air-propelling kicks.
omissions.reason: Runtime transformation, movement propulsion, and form-specific attack behavior are unsupported. Compression power and Armament enhancement are adapted into tiered damage upgrades.

omissions.sourceTrait: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika awakening and Gear 5's white-haired transformation.
omissions.reason: Forms are encounter selections rather than runtime transformations, and no form is declared because the design prioritizes the three-path attack kit. The awakening is not claimed as implemented.

omissions.sourceTrait: Awakening that turns the environment and other living beings into rubber.
omissions.reason: No environment mutation or arbitrary target transformation exists in the contract.
Observation is represented by reveal and targeting priority only; several-seconds-ahead prediction and its countermeasures are not defined by the supplied evidence or contract.

omissions.sourceTrait: Emission and Internal Destruction advanced Armament applications.
omissions.reason: Their ranged blast and internal-destruction behaviors are not modeled. Armament is represented only through damage upgrades.
No separate coating, resource, status, or damage-bypass mechanic is declared; the characteristic enhancement is not distinguished from ordinary damage upgrades.

omissions.sourceTrait: Conqueror's Haki knocking weak-willed people or animals unconscious.
omissions.reason: A reliable incapacitating control effect would require an explicit status/control implementation and supplied resistance context; it is omitted.

omissions.sourceTrait: Immunity to electric attacks and resistance to most blunt-force attacks.
omissions.reason: Damage-type resistances and generic defensive modifiers are outside the default contract. No unsupported immunity is asserted.

omissions.sourceTrait: Sharp weapons as an effective weakness.
omissions.reason: Enemy damage typing and weakness evaluation require game context not supplied here.

uncertainties: The source does not specify exact attack ranges, cadence, damage values, or recovery requirements; all numeric values are neutral design estimates within the configured bands.
The supplied evidence does not define the full conditions, reliability, or countermeasures for Future Sight, Emission, Internal Destruction, or Conqueror's coating.
Water and Sea-Prism Stone disabling effects are not implemented because the unit specification lacks a supplied environmental-status context.
Poison immunity is omitted because its complete scope and toxin thresholds are unspecified.

Crew members, Grand Fleet support, bounty, affiliations, family ties, and narrative accomplishments are identity and lore facts rather than executable unit mechanics in this compact three-path design.
The base attack is a source-specific adaptation of Gum-Gum Pistol; it does not claim a complete catalog of Luffy's named attacks or Gear 4 and Gear 5 applications.

effectiveLimits.prominentMechanicCounting: Every declared ability plus every declared form plus one if control is used plus one if damage-over-time is used. Locked declarations still count. Resources do not directly count, but their associated abilities and forms do.

forms.requirements: empty; grant-form upgrade or explicit external unlock

effectiveLimits.formLimitations: Forms are external encounter selections. They do not switch at runtime, revert, enforce mutually exclusive modes, or make arbitrary combinations safe. A grant-form upgrade unlocks a later external build selection.
effectiveLimits.intervalCadence: For an enabled primary interval action, scheduled period = max(trigger.intervalSeconds, timing.cooldownSeconds). A fixed trigger interval can mask cooldown upgrades. A trigger floor of 0.15 seconds allows cooldown upgrades down to that floor; use a different explicit interval only when intentional. Windup delays resolution separately.
effectiveLimits.delivery: Direct-strike and line-strike can have range up to the same configured maximum as projectiles. Melee does not imply short range. Projectile primary aim count and collateral pierce are separate; do not infer a combined minimum target cap.
